item.description: Sadler’s Wells East, London The Olivier-winner draws on his Cameroonian heritage in a visceral show, with music and movement that speak as one Dickson Mbi won an Olivier award for his last major dance piece, Enowate , a result that surprised some of us who saw a talented artist still mastering the craft of choreographing a full-length work.
